  CITY OF SOUTH GATE
  AMENDED
  NOTICE OF RECESSED SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MEETING

A Recessed Special City Council Meeting will be held December 13, 2022 at 6:00 p.m., in the City Council
Chambers, to address each of the items posted on the agenda for the Special City Council Meeting scheduled
on December 8, 2022. We invite the public to participate in this meeting. Copies of the documents related to
the City Council Meeting are available for review during normal business hours at City Hall in the City
Clerk’s Office or on the City’s Website as the December 8, 2022 Special City Council Meeting Agenda. If
you have any questions, please contact the City Clerk’s Office at (323) 563-9573.

CITY OF SOUTH GATE
SOUTH GATE CITY COUNCIL, SOUTH GATE HOUSING AUTHORITY,
  SERVING AS THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE COMMUNITY
  DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF SOUTH GATE,
SOUTH GATE UTILITY AUTHORITY, SOUTH GATE PUBLIC FINANCE
 AUTHORITY, AND SOUTH GATE PUBLIC ACCESS CORPORATION
  RECESS SPECIAL JOINT MEETING
  MINUTES
  FROM DECEMBER 8, 2022 to DECEMBER 13, 2022

  TUESDAY, DECEMBER 13, 2022

CALL TO ORDER  The Recess Special Joint meeting of the City Council, Housing Authority,
  Successor Agency, Utility Authority, Public Finance Authority and Public
  Access Corporation was called to order by Mayor/Chairperson Rios at
  6:00 p.m.

ROLL CALL  Yodit Glaze, City Clerk

PRESENT  Mayor/Chair Al Rios, Vice Mayor/Vice Chair Maria del Pilar Avalos,
  Council/Authority/Agency Member/Director Joshua Barron,
  Council/Authority/Agency Member/Director Maria Davila, and
  Council/Authority/Agency Member/Director Gil Hurtado; City Treasurer
  Jose De La Paz, City Manager/Executive Director Chris Jeffers, City
  Attorney/Authority Counsel Raul F. Salinas

1
ELECTION ADMIN  The City Council adopted Resolution No. 2022-70-CC entitled -
  Resolution of the City Council of the City of South Gate, California,
  reciting the facts of the General Municipal Election held on Tuesday,
  November 8, 2022, and declaring the results and such other matters as
  provided by law, by motion of Council/Authority/Agency Member/
  Director Davila and seconded by Vice Mayor/Vice Chair Avalos.

  Mayor Rios asked if anyone in the audience and zoom wished to speak on
  this item. Seeing no one step forward; Mayor Rios closed the audience
  portion.

  Staff's recommendation to reaffirm item 1 was approved by motion of
  Council Hurtado and seconded by Council Member Davila.

  ROLL CALL: Mayor/Chair Rios, yes; Vice Mayor/ Vice Chair Avalos,
  yes; Council/Authority/Agency Member/Director Barron, abstained;
  Council/Authority/Agency Member/Director Davila, yes;
  Council/Authority/Agency Member/Director Hurtado, yes.
   RECESS SPECIAL JOINT COUNCIL, HOUSING AUTHORITY, SUCCESSOR
  AGENCY, UTILITY AUTHORITY, PUBLIC FINANCE AUTHORITY & PUBLIC
  ACCESS CORPORATION MINUTES OF DECEMBER 13, 2022
2
ELECTION ADMIN  The City Council authorized the administration of the Oath of Office (by
  ballot order) to the newly elected and re-elected City officials elected from
  the General Municipal Election on November 8, 2022:

  a. City Council Member, Joshua Barron;
  b. City Council Member, Al Rios;
  c. City Clerk, Yodit Glaze; and
  d. City Treasurer, Jose De La Paz

  The Oath of Office was administered to Council Member Barron, City
  Clerk Glaze and City Treasurer De La Paz on December 8, 2022.

  The Oath of Office was administered to Council Member Rios by Pastor
  Nick Garife.
3
COUNCIL
RE-ORGANIZATION  The City Council:

  a. Reorganized the Council by nominating and selecting a new Mayor
  and new Vice Mayor for a one-year term; the selection was ratified by
  a majority vote of the City Council; and

  b. Authorized the Oaths of Office to be administered to the newly
  selected Mayor and Vice Mayor.

  Vice Mayor Avalos was nominated as Mayor by motion of Council
  Member Barron and seconded by Council Member Hurtado.

  ROLL CALL: Council Member Barron, yes; Council Member Davila,
  yes; Council Member Hurtado, yes; Mayor Rios, yes; Vice Mayor Avalos,
  yes.

  Council Member Hurtado was nominated for Vice Mayor by motion of
  Council Member Davila and seconded by Mayor Avalos.

  ROLL CALL: Council Member Barron, yes; Council Member Davila,
  yes; Council Member Hurtado, yes; Council Member Rios, yes; Mayor
  Avalos, yes.

  The South Gate Housing Authority reorganized the South Gate Housing
  Authority by nominating and selecting a new Chair and new Vice Chair
  for a one-year term; the selection was ratified by a majority vote of the
  South Gate Housing Authority.

  The Successor Agency to the Community Development Commission of
  the City of South Gate reorganized the Successor Agency to the
  Community Development Commission of the City of South Gate by
  nominating and selecting a new Chair and new Vice Chair for a one-year

  Vice Chair Avalos was nominated as Chair by motion of Authority
  Member Barron and seconded by Authority Member Hurtado.

  ROLL CALL: Agency Member Barron, yes; Agency Member Davila,
  yes; Agency Member Hurtado, yes; Chair Rios, yes; Vice Chair Avalos,
  yes.

  Authority Member Hurtado was nominated for Vice Chair by motion of
  Authority Member Davila and seconded by Chair Avalos.

  ROLL CALL: Agency Member Barron, yes; Agency Member Davila,
  yes; Agency Member Hurtado, yes; Agency Member Rios, yes; Chair
  Avalos, yes.

  The South Gate Utility Authority reorganized the South Gate Utility
  Authority by nominating and selecting a new Chair and new Vice Chair
  for a one-year term; the selection was ratified by a majority vote of the
  South Gate Utility Authority.

  Vice Chair Avalos was nominated as Chair by motion of Director Barron

  ROLL CALL: Director Barron, yes; Director Davila, yes; Director

  Mayor Rios asked if anyone in the audience and zoom wished to speak on

  Mario Dominguez asked for clarification on all these committees.

  Having no one else come forward, Mayor Rios closed the audience
  portion.

  Mr. Salinas stated that each of these agencies or entities involving the City
  of South Gate are filled by Members of the City Council wearing different
  hats.

I  ADJOURNMENT  Mayor/Chair Avalos unanimously recessed the meeting at 6:43 p.m. and
  seconded by Vice Mayor/Vice Chair Hurtado.

  PASSED and APPROVED this 14th day of February 2023.
